recommendation.scope: A7 vs A8 matched-mechanism descriptive decomposition, zero inference, separately authorised
recommendation.reason: BARR-M1 is scoped to A0/A1/A8. Adding A7 would silently extend it and would also change the study from a three-policy comparison to a component-isolation analysis with a different claim class.

segmentation_harm_vs_clinical_safety.segmentation_harm: A Dice decrease caused by executing the regional branch on a specific case. It is a descriptive per-case image-segmentation outcome, measured against a frozen reference arm with ground truth used only for scoring.
segmentation_harm_vs_clinical_safety.clinical_safety: A patient-outcome property (missed diagnosis, delayed care, adverse event). It requires clinical endpoints, a clinical population, prospective design and regulatory framing — none of which exist here.
segmentation_harm_vs_clinical_safety.permitted_wording: segmentation-harm mitigation / reduction in harmful refinement
